documentation_review.configuration: Core governance/profile configuration and Workbench integration setup are documented.
documentation_review.platform: Windows x64 and the recorded Android API 35 x86_64 scenarios are bounded to actual evidence; Linux WSL2 is headless only; macOS/iOS and Linux graphical/bare-metal acceptance are not claimed.
documentation_review.security: Both GitHub private vulnerability-reporting settings are enabled. Core and Workbench security policies identify their trust and support boundaries.

documentation_review.migration: Core adoption guidance includes dry-run; Workbench directs existing-repository governance to Core and describes explicit Android export behavior. No automatic consumer migration is claimed.
documentation_review.support: Both repositories provide issue/support guidance and separate vulnerability reporting; no unsupported LTS or platform promise is added.
